oneOf.description: The producer did not declare whether measurements were captured.
Measurements were not captured; this does not mean content is absent.
Only some applicable content or properties were measured.
Measurements cover all applicable content in the document.

face_index.description: Zero-based face index within a font collection.

file_sha256.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the backing font file, when available.

font_substitutions.description: Requested-to-resolved family substitutions observed during layout.

fonts.description: Resolved font faces that were actually used during layout.

id.description: Native ID or deterministic physical XML path within `part`.

part.description:
Canonical package-relative OPC part containing the editable source node.
The part is an inseparable component of the complete source identity.
